They were led by 16th-year head coach [[Chris Mooney (basketball)|Chris Mooney]] and played their home games at the [[Robins Center]] as members of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. They finished the season 14–9, 6–5 in A-10 play to finish in 8th place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the A-10 tournament to [[2020–21 Duquesne Dukes men's basketball team|Duquesne]]. They received an invitation to the NIT where they defeated [[2020–21 Toledo Rockets men's basketball team|Toledo]] in the first round before losing in the quarterfinals to [[2020–21 Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball team|Mississippi State]]. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Richmond Spiders men's basketball team|Spiders]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 24–7, 14–4 in [[2019–20 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in second place.
